control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: danger tagging failure on TX-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was serious injury requiring hospitalisation, with 2 persons injured and 90 days lost.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on TX-9001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-9001 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 3 August 2009 an incident occurred on TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
